description: This file defines the Review class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing reviews of projects. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and summarizing review data, as well as associations with users and projects.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Manages project reviews, including CRUD operations, evaluations, and history tracking.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a review object for a specific project.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the review data, particularly the presence of the project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the review record in the database.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Returns a list of projects that are under review or eligible for review, optionally filtered by node.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a comprehensive list of projects with review status, filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: assigned
methods.description: Fetches reviews assigned to a particular user.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Retrieves the history of reviews for a user.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a specific review by ID.

methods.name: getEvaluation
methods.description: Builds an evaluation report for a review by a user, including criteria scores and comments.

methods.name: recount
methods.description: Calculates and updates the average score of a review based on completed user reviews.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Marks a review as closed by updating its status.
